summary: Frontend-only testing of the new admin image management feature (rotate / crop / hide / reset) on the Fluoro Seals site plus public-page regression. All 6 requested flows passed: admin login shows 12 media slots with correct action sets (heroVideo has Hide+Reset only, no Rotate/Crop; the other 11 image slots have Rotate, Crop, Hide, Reset); Rotate produced toast 'Rotated 90 - remember to save.', changed slot value to a new /api/files/...webp URL and updated the preview; Reset restored the exact original URL; Crop dialog opened with cropper image, 4 aspect preset pills and zoom slider, Apply crop produced toast 'Cropped - remember to save.' and a new /api/files/...webp URL, Cancel closed the dialog with the slot value unchanged (verified on desktop 1920 and mobile 390); Hide END-TO-END verified: hidden EyeOff placeholder (admin-image-hidden-story) + amber warning + URL input removed, save toast 'Saved - reload the site to see it live.', homepage story-section img count 1 -> 0 and /about story image 1 -> 0 (fully absent from DOM), then Reset + Save restored both to 1. Regression: Home, /services, /capabilities, /projects, /founder, /import-substitution render all images with zero broken images (naturalWidth>0), brochure buttons absent in all 3 locations (no brochure set), RFQ form submits successfully (success panel + toast). Site state left clean: GET /api/site-images contains no '__hidden__' values and story is back to the original artifact URL; the 2 TEST enquiry docs created during testing were deleted from MongoDB.

issues: The 112x112 video preview renders as a solid black square (autoplay muted video shows frame 0 / no poster). Cosmetic only - adding poster={heroBackdrop} would make the slot recognisable.
Aspect preset pills (Wide 16:9 / Standard 4:3 / Square 1:1 / Tall 3:4) and the zoom range input have no data-testid, so tests must fall back to role/name selectors. Low priority testability gap only.

action_items: Optional: add data-testid to crop dialog aspect pills and zoom slider (e.g. admin-crop-aspect-<label>, admin-crop-zoom).
Optional: add poster to the admin heroVideo preview so it is not a black square.
critical_code_review_comments: Admin.jsx is 660 lines and holds LoginCard + CropDialog + MediaSlot + BrochureSlot + page shell; consider splitting into components/admin/* to stay under the 700-line guideline.

CropDialog resets crop/zoom in a useEffect keyed on [open, aspect] - correct today, but note aspect itself is not reset on reopen, so a previously chosen preset persists across dialog opens (intentional? minor UX ambiguity).

MediaSlot.transform() sends the current slot value; chained rotate/crop operations keep creating new object-storage files with no cleanup - orphaned /api/files webp objects will accumulate over time (consider GC or overwrite).
seed_data_creation: None persisted. 2 TEST enquiries created while validating the RFQ form were deleted from db.enquiries. No transform artifacts were saved to site-images (all reset before/after save).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 5 covered the image edit feature (rotate/crop/hide/reset) end to end via Playwright on the public preview URL. Transform calls complete in ~3-8s; a 40x1s poll on the slot input value is reliable. Note: POST /api/contact rejects reserved TLDs like example.test with 422 (pydantic EmailStr) - use @example.com in RFQ tests. Site state is clean: no '__hidden__' slots, story slot = original artifact URL.
rca_of_the_issue: The only failure seen during testing (RFQ 422) was caused by my own test data - email 'qa.bot@example.test' is rejected by pydantic EmailStr as a reserved/special-use domain. Re-run with @example.com returned 200 and the UI success panel; this is correct validation behaviour, not a product bug. Email delivery still logs 401 from integrations.emergentagent.com (placeholder key) but fails gracefully as documented.
